results.name: Dumbbell Front Rack Lunge
instructions: Begin by standing with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand. Rack the dumbbells on your shoulders by bending your elbows and positioning your upper arms parallel to the floor.
Keep your chest up, and step forward with your right leg. Lower your body by bending both knees until your right thigh is parallel to the floor and your left knee is just above the floor.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position. Repeat the movement with your left leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your front foot flat on the floor and your back foot balanced on the ball of your foot.
Focus on keeping your weight evenly distributed between both legs.
Use a weight that allows for proper form and control throughout the exercise to prevent strain or injury.
results.description: Dumbbell Front Rack Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Dumbbell Front Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand and racking them on your shoulders with your elbows pointing forward.
Begin the movement by pushing your hips back and bending your knees to lower into a squat position.
Continue lowering yourself until your thighs are parallel to the floor, ensuring your knees stay in line with your toes and your back remains straight.
Push through your heels to stand back up, extending your hips and knees fully to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your elbows stay up and forward to keep the dumbbells stable on your shoulders.
Avoid letting your knees collapse inward; keep them aligned with your toes.
Maintain a neutral spine and avoid rounding your back.
results.description: Dumbbell Front Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Lower Back.

results.name: Dumbbell Glute Bridge
instructions: Begin by lying on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place a dumbbell horizontally across your hips, holding it securely with both hands.
Engage your core and glutes, and press through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling. Your body should form a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement, holding for a brief moment while keeping the dumbbell stable on your hips.
Lower your hips back to the starting position in a controlled manner without letting your glutes touch the floor. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your knees stay aligned with your toes and do not splay outwards.
Focus on squeezing your glutes at the top to maximize muscle activation.
Avoid arching your lower back; maintain a neutral spine.
results.description: Dumbbell Glute Bridge is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Core.

results.name: Dumbbell Goblet 2 Sec Hold Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands, between your palms. Keep your elbows pointed downward.
Push your hips back and bend your knees until your thighs are just lower than parallel to the floor.
Hold the squat position for 2 seconds, keeping your chest up and your weight distributed evenly through your heels.
Push through your heels to return to the standing position, squeezing your glutes at the top. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your knees track over your toes and do not cave inward during the squat.
Focus on keeping your weight on your heels to engage your glutes and hamstrings.
Maintain a neutral spine and avoid rounding your lower back.
results.description: Dumbbell Goblet 2 Sec Hold Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings.

results.name: Dumbbell Goblet Curtsy Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands, between your palms. Keep your elbows pointed downward.
Step your right foot behind and to the outside of your left foot, lowering your body into a curtsy lunge.
Bend both knees until your right knee almost touches the floor. Keep your chest up and your weight evenly distributed.
Push through your left heel to return to the starting position. Repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Ensure your front knee tracks over your toes and does not extend past your toes during the lunge.
Focus on keeping your weight on your front heel to engage your glutes and hamstrings.
Maintain a neutral spine and avoid rounding your lower back.
results.description: Dumbbell Goblet Curtsy Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Dumbbell Goblet Forward Lunge
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands, elbows pointing down.
Take a step forward with one leg and begin descending by bending both knees.
Descend until your front thigh is parallel to the ground and your back knee is just above the floor.
Push through the heel of your front foot to return to the starting position, then repeat on the opposite leg.
tips: Ensure your front knee stays aligned with your foot and does not travel past your toes.
Engage your core muscles for added stability during the lunge.
Hold the dumbbell close to your chest to maintain proper posture and balance.
results.description: Dumbbell Goblet Forward Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Dumbbell Goblet Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands.
Step one foot backward and bend both knees, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your chest up and your front foot flat as you lower into the lunge.
Push through your front foot to return to standing, then repeat with the opposite leg.
tips: Step far enough back to maintain a stable lunge position.
Align your front knee with your toes.
Avoid pushing off excessively with your back foot as you stand.
Inhale as you lower and exhale as you return to standing.
results.description: Dumbbell Goblet Reverse Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves, Core.

results.name: Dumbbell Goblet Split Squat Front Foot Elevated
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands, between your palms. Keep your elbows pointed downward.
Place your right foot on a step, while keeping your left leg extended on your forefoot on the floor behind you.
Lower your body by bending the front knee to approximately 90 degrees. Your left knee should hover just above the floor.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position. Complete the desired number of repetitions on one side before switching to the other leg.
tips: Ensure your front knee tracks over your toes and does not extend beyond them.
Use a high enough step to perform the exercise comfortably.
Focus on keeping your weight distributed evenly between both feet during the squat.
results.description: Dumbbell Goblet Split Squat Front Foot Elevated is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings.

results.name: Dumbbell Goblet Split Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands, between your palms. Keep your elbows pointed downward.
Step your right foot forward into a split stance, ensuring your left foot remains stationary and slightly elevated on your forefoot.

Lower your body by bending both knees to approximately 90 degrees, keeping your chest up and back straight. Your right knee should be directly above your right ankle, and your left knee should hover just above the floor.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position. Complete the desired number of repetitions on one side before switching to the other leg.
tips: Ensure your front knee tracks over your toes and does not extend beyond them.
Maintain a straight back and avoid leaning forward or rounding your shoulders.
Focus on keeping your weight distributed evenly between both feet during the squat.
results.description: Dumbbell Goblet Split Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings.

results.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands, between your palms. Keep your elbows pointed downward.
Push your hips back and bend your knees, making sure to keep your weight on your heels.
Continue lowering yourself until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, or as low as your mobility allows, while maintaining a straight back and keeping the dumbbell close to your chest.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position, straightening your legs and extending your hips fully at the top.
tips: Ensure your knees track over your toes and do not cave inward.
Maintain a neutral spine and avoid rounding your back.
Focus on pushing through your heels to engage your glutes and quadriceps effectively.
results.description: Dumbbell Goblet Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Adductors.
